field.label: Enable content filtering
field.help: Block websites of the categories you select. Devices must use this firewall as their DNS server.

field.label: Blocked websites answer with
field.help: What a device receives when it asks for a blocked website. "Does not exist" is the clearest.

field.label: Always block these websites
field.help: For everyone, in addition to the categories. For wildcards and per-device rules use Protection > Web Control.

field.label: Never block these websites
field.help: Exceptions to the categories, for example a news site that is listed as social media.

field.label: Force safe search
field.help: Search engines (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo) hide explicit results.

field.label: YouTube restricted mode
field.help: Hides videos that may be unsuitable.

field.label: Block known bad addresses
field.help: Lists of internet addresses used by botnets and attackers, downloaded from the cloud server.

field.label: Direction
field.help: "Both directions" also stops attackers on these lists from reaching the firewall.

field.label: Cloud server address
field.help: Where the lists come from, for example http://192.168.1.73:8080/feeds. This one server provides website categories, bad addresses, malware hashes and virus signatures.
